name: Account reputation only raises standings and follows absolute values
contract: Account-wide reputation keeps the best absolute standing of the account's characters: a higher own standing is never lowered by a weaker sibling, a gain on an alt flows back to the main at its next login, and a loss on one character does not lower the others. Characters with different base standings for the same faction share the absolute value, not the stored offset. Only standing a sibling earned above its own base is shared, so an untouched alt of another race does not lift anyone to its racial base, and a sibling's loss below its base never raises anyone.
